invariants.rationale: The method calls element.getName(), so element and its name must not be null.
The method only handles these four layer types; likely, the input element's name should be one of them.
map is passed to all helper methods and thus should not be null.
parentLayers is also passed to all helper methods and thus should not be null.
tmxFile is used in all but one helper method call, so it should be non-null to avoid errors.
